newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Kin Yat offers 85 mln shrs at HK$1.28/shr.
newsitem.headline: HK's Kin Yat offers 85 mln shrs at HK$1.28/shr.

text.p: Remote control toy car manufacturer Kin Yat Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it is issuing 85 million shares at HK$1.28 each in an initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong.
The issue price represents a prospective price/earnings multiple of 5.0 times on a weighted average basis and 6.3 times on a proforma fully-diluted basis.
The IPO will run from April 16 to 21 and dealing in the company's shares is expected to begin on May 1.
Lippo Securities is the sponsor and manager of the issue.
The Hong Kong-based company manufactures toy cars and electrical household appliances.
Radio control and remote control toy cars, and road racing sets accounted for 81 percent of the company turnover in the year ended March 31, 1996.
Kin Yat currently operates two production facilities in Shenzhen on 26 production lines.

The net proceeds of HK$96.80 million after expenses will be used for construction of production facilities in Baoan, to buy machinery, to upgrade equipment, to expand products development project and for general working capital.
The company forecasts a combined profit after taxation and minority interest but before extraordinanry item of not less than HK$65 million for the year ended in March 31, 1997.
The company said the proforma annual dividend yield is 7.5 percent and adjusted net tangilble asset value per share is HK$0.562.
Kin Yat reported a profit of HK$30.3 million for the year ended in March 1996, up from HK$20.8 million in 1995 and HK$18.6 million in 1994.
